autumn.question: A red ribbon is 99 centimeters long and a blue ribbon is 72 centimeters long. Autumn cuts both ribbons into pieces of the same whole-number length, with nothing left over. What is the greatest possible length of each piece? Enter the length in centimeters.

follow_up_questions.question: Autumn cuts a 99-centimeter red ribbon and a 72-centimeter blue ribbon into 9-centimeter pieces, with nothing left over. How many red pieces does she get? Enter a whole number.
